text:
marta-mkt: Quick idea: launch a "SparkLabs" mini-program — monthly 3-part tutorial series + 1 OSS mini-refapp + a short benchmark note. target: devs who want to try Redwood in <10 minutes. thoughts? :sparkles:
devrel-jo: big yes. make each tutorial one page, 2-4 minute read, 1 runnable snippet, and a tiny Docker refapp in the repo. call it "Try in 5".
tom-eng: refapp constraints: single-file app (python/express), env var for REDWOOD_API_KEY, 3 endpoints (/health, /generate, /embed). single Dockerfile + README. I'll make a repo template.
marta-mkt: distribution: blog post + thread + 60s demo video + community newsletter. also plan a 30-min AMA after the 2nd release.
nora-ux: visuals: a standard GIF template (request -> response) and a compact benchmark card design. will provide figma assets.
lee-sales: inbound routing: blog form with fields (use-case, team size, interest-level), route to CRM via Zap if "request demo" checked. also add a badge for "enterprise" leads to trigger AE outreach.
devrel-jo: content cadence proposal:
- Week 0: scaffold repo + baseline benchmark (tom)
- Week 1: Snack A: "Build reranking in 10" + refapp v0 (jo)
- Week 2: Snack B: "Memory+chat in 10" + refapp ext (jo)
- Week 3: Snack C: "Embeddings for search in 5" + publish summary + AMA
marta-mkt: benchmark narrative: show three columns: hosted small (fast), dedicated baseline (predictable), private-quantized (cheap). metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens. show a short note on SLO tradeoffs.
tom-eng: I'll provide bench scripts and a CSV artifact. plan: run on a representative 256-token workload. add a small CI job to publish artifacts on release.
devrel-jo: PR play: tag first-time contributors with "good first refapp". encourage community templates and list top contributors in month-end post.
nora-ux: CTA designs: primary = "Try in 5" button that opens a pre-filled Replit/Docker run modal; secondary = "Request a demo" for enterprise.
lee-sales: for leads: include hidden field for company size and region. small companies -> nurture drip; enterprise -> AE + Solutions Eng queue.
build-bot: checklist updated: repo template created, CI skeleton, bench script placeholder. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sparklabs-template (placeholder)
marta-mkt: messaging line examples:
- "Ship an LLM feature in under 10 minutes with Redwood."
- "Tiny refapps. Real benchmarks. Low friction."
devrel-jo: next steps: I'll draft Snack A this afternoon and open the repo. Tom, can you draft bench scripts by EOD Friday? Nora, can you share GIF template by Monday? Lee, can you confirm inbound routing flow with ops?
tom-eng: yes to EOD Friday.
nora-ux: will do Monday.
lee-sales: I'll sync w/ops tomorrow and report back.
marta-mkt: cool. aim to soft-launch the pilot in 4 weeks. :rocket:
